label: VERIFIED
extraction: Orchestrator Pipeline security triggers and verification checklist. Security-reviewer pulled in when diff touches: authentication/authorization, user-input handling, database queries, file-system paths, external API calls, cryptography, secrets/credentials. Verification: size tier stated and matched work; Gate 1 and Gate 2 honored; security-reviewer ran iff security trigger touched; commits conventional and scoped to one logical change; new/changed behavior has tests; coverage >=80% per testing.md. Handoff artifacts: task_list from Plan drives Implement loop; larger work emits PRD/architecture/system_design under docs/; review findings CRITICAL/HIGH must be resolved before Gate 2. Phases delegate to existing ECC agents/commands: /feature-dev, /plan, /code-review, /build-fix, /refactor-clean, /gan-build, plus tdd-workflow skill. Adds shared size classifier and two gates on top so one umbrella covers all five operations consistently.
